Frostfire Quirk.name: Frostfire Quirk
Frostfire Quirk.description:
❄️ Fire and ice run through your whole body at once: pale-blue flames that leave frost behind.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Fire and Ice: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you throw a frost-leaving flame jet about three meters and spread a steaming sheet of ice about five.
📈 With training: flame-burst hops, warm-veined ice cuffs, a fog wall where heat meets cold, a temperature lock on an object or patch of ground, and thermal shock that cracks stone, locks and ice.
⚠️ Each side checks the other: your fire thaws your own ice, and rain blunts the flame.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as your body temperature swings between fever and deep chill.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Shoto Todoroki (Half-Cold Half-Hot), but with no left-right split.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Hoarfrost Jet, Cinder Glaze
🛡️ Resists: fire, cold
Frostfire Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: flame and frost together from any skin, no left-right split; at first a three-meter riming flame jet or a five-meter steaming ice sheet in a second or two. More needs learned techniques. Limits: their fire thaws their ice in moments unless held; rain or sealed rooms blunt the flame, heat thins the frost. Quirk Strain: light: jet, glaze; moderate: burst hop, steaming cuff, fog curtain; heavy: temperature lock, thermal fracture, close sear; severe: signature shockwave, warding a room. Fusion: Fire and Ice at about half single-nature range and force; lacks lances, fire flight, permanent ice walls, white heat; only it has thermal shock (cracks stone, locks, ice), fog walls and temperature locks (object or ground held at one extreme). Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed public fire or ice, or cracking locks, doors or pavement, brings criminal, property and burglary charges. Look: pale-blue fire on frosted skin.
